purpose: A starter summarisation prompt with an annotated source. Replace it with your own sources.
template:
Summarise the following report in under 120 words, as connected prose.

In March 2026 the Halden works replaced its overnight batch reconciliation with an incremental one. The old process ran for 4 hours and 20 minutes and finished at 06:10, twenty minutes after the first shift began. The new process runs in 38 minutes. Ingrid Sorensen, who had run the old process for eleven years, wrote the replacement over a fortnight. In its first month the new process found 213 discrepancies, of which 9 were genuine stock errors and the rest were timing artefacts of the old system it replaced.
